title: Sonder brand relaunches as an AI travel site with curated rentals
excerpt: Sonder's brand name and website were acquired by a travel company that's relaunching it as an AI-powered, curated guide to urban stays.
content_html:
Why this AI travel company is bringing Sonder back from the dead

By Kelsey Vlamis

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

Sonder is back. Sort of.

TravelAI, a Canadian AI travel company, announced Monday it purchased the Sonder brand and relaunched Sonder.com. The deal did not include Sonder properties or its operating business.

Sonder, which operated boutique hotels and short-term rentals, filed for bankruptcy and shuttered its operations in November after hotel giant Marriott International abruptly ended its partnership with the Airbnb rival. Guests were forced to vacate properties mid-stay, while employees were left without jobs overnight.

Despite the chaotic ending to a travel company valued at $2.2 billion in 2021, TravelAI said the Sonder name still carries weight with travelers — and in search results.

"There is a large percentage of travelers who still search for Sonder every month who were unaware of the issues from last November," John Lyotier, CEO and founder of TravelAI, told Business Insider. "What they remember is that they had a great travel experience."

The new Sonder will not operate properties or take reservations. Instead, it will operate as an AI-powered, curated list of urban stays, including boutique hotels, apartments, and homes, and will send users to third-party sites to book, like Vrbo, Expedia, and Booking.com.

Lyotier said TravelAI is trying to capitalize on the "search equity and residual traffic" to Sonder.com to give travelers the same kinds of quality, unique stays that they expected at Sonder properties.

Properties featured on the site meet what TravelAI calls the "Sonder Bar." TravelAI's system bases its curation on reviews, ratings, photos, neighborhood characteristics, and features identified in former Sonder properties.

Of the 10 million properties TravelAI can curate from its partner sites, only about 5% meet the Sonder Bar, Lyotier said.

While he declined to share what TravelAI paid for the Sonder brand and website, he said it was a "good value," that the payback will be measured in "months, not years," and that he has a target of $100 million in bookings via Sonder.com in the first year. As of Monday afternoon, Lyotier said the platform had already generated bookings. The company receives a commission when customers click through and book.

TravelAI has acquired several travel brands over the past several years, including Casai.com, OwnerDirect.com, and Smarttours.com. Sonder is its highest-profile brand acquisition to date, Lyotier said.

Through the Sonder acquisition, Lyotier said TravelAI is also hoping to draw attention to the bigger-picture AI travel technologies it's working on.

That includes Sonder Concierge, a beta tool that recommends properties based on what it learns about an individual traveler's preferences. TravelAI also launched an AI memory tool last month, Traveler.md, that's designed to make those preferences usable across different travel sites and AI assistants.

With relaunching Sonder.com, Lyotier said the company will need to communicate to customers that it's not the same brand that booted them out of hotels and left them stranded on vacation last fall.

"That's a challenge we'll have — making sure that the former customers understand that we are not that old Sonder."

为什么这家人工智能旅游公司能让 Sonder 起死回生

作者：Kelsey Vlamis 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。

没有就回来了。 有点像。

加拿大人工智能旅游公司 TravelAI 周一宣布收购 Sonder 品牌并重新推出 Sonder.com。 该交易不包括盛达澳地产或其运营业务。

经营精品酒店和短期租赁的 Sonder 在酒店巨头万豪国际集团突然终止与 Airbnb 竞争对手的合作关系后，于 11 月申请破产并关闭其业务。 客人被迫在住宿中途离开酒店，而员工则一夜之间失业。

尽管一家价值 22 亿美元的旅游公司在 2021 年遭遇了混乱的结局，但 TravelAI 表示，Sonder 这个名字仍然在旅行者中以及搜索结果中具有重要意义。

TravelAI 首席执行官兼创始人约翰·利奥蒂尔 (John Lyotier) 告诉《商业内幕》(Business Insider)：“仍有很大一部分每月仍在搜索 Sonder 的旅行者并没有意识到去年 11 月以来出现的问题。” “他们记得的是，他们有一次很棒的旅行经历。”

新的 Sonder 将不会经营酒店或接受预订。 相反，它将作为人工智能驱动的、精心策划的城市住宿列表运行，包括精品酒店、公寓和住宅，并将用户引导至第三方网站进行预订，例如 Vrbo、Expedia 和 Booking.com。

Lyotier 表示，TravelAI 正试图利用 Sonder.com 的“搜索资产和剩余流量”，为旅行者提供与他们在 Sonder 酒店所期望的相同的优质、独特的住宿体验。

该网站上的特色房产符合 TravelAI 所说的“Sonder Bar”。 TravelAI 的系统根据评论、评级、照片、社区特征以及前 Sonder 酒店中确定的功能进行管理。

Lyotier 表示，在 TravelAI 可以从其合作伙伴网站策划的 1000 万处房产中，只有约 5% 符合 Sonder Bar 要求。

虽然他拒绝透露 TravelAI 为 Sonder 品牌和网站支付的费用，但他表示这是一个“物超所值”的投资回报将以“数月而不是数年”来衡量，而且他的目标是第一年通过 Sonder.com 实现 1 亿美元的预订。 截至周一下午，Lyotier 表示该平台已经产生预订。 当客户点击并预订时，该公司会收到佣金。

TravelAI在过去几年中收购了多个旅游品牌，包括Casai.com、OwnerDirect.com和Smarttours.com。 Lyotier 表示，Sonder 是迄今为止最引人注目的品牌收购。

Lyotier 表示，通过收购 Sonder，TravelAI 还希望引起人们对其正在开发的人工智能旅行技术的关注。

其中包括 Sonder Concierge，这是一款测试版工具，可根据了解的单个旅行者的偏好来推荐酒店。 TravelAI 上个月还推出了一款人工智能记忆工具 Traveler.md，旨在让这些偏好可以在不同的旅游网站和人工智能助手中使用。

Lyotier 表示，在重新推出 Sonder.com 时，该公司需要向客户传达这样的信息：去年秋天将他们赶出酒店并让他们在度假时滞留的不是同一个品牌。

“这是我们面临的一个挑战——确保以前的客户明白我们不是那么老的 Sonder。”
